newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT- Brazil's CSN still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Brazil's CSN still a buy.

text.p: -- Flemings Research said in a report it was reiterating its buy rating on Brazilian steel company Companhia Siderurgica Nacional (CSN).
-- It said CSN 1996 profits of 272.5 million reais were above Flemings' earnings estimate of 245.4 million.
-- It said the company was likely to show record levels of profitability in the third and fourth quarters of 1996.
-- Also, it said CSN was inaugurating a new era in its history, with a professional management team which could lead to a more aggressive labor force reduction.
-- CSN's common shares were trading at 37.40 reais, up 1.08 percent.
